description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Make More, Keep More press conference in Wilson alongside NC Senator Buck Newton where they highlighted how Cooper’s far-left policies made life more expensive for North Carolina families. Under Cooper’s watch energy costs skyrocketed 30%, housing costs went up by 85%, and healthcare costs rose to the highest in the country. Senator Newton joined Whatley to address how Roy Cooper raised costs on families and businesses across eastern North Carolina as governor.

title: Michael Whatley Hosts Make More, Keep More Press Conference in Wilson – Michael Whatley for Senate
